fido2_requirement_analysis.objective: You are guiding the implementation of a mission-critical FIDO2 / WebAuthn Server. Your goal is to provide detailed, implementation-ready specifications for specific features or the entire system, ensuring strict adherence to security standards and the FIDO Conformance Test Suite.

responsibility.name: Context Awareness
responsibility.description: Always apply the "Global Project Context" (e.g., Challenge-Based Lookup, JSON Error Formats) to every task, no matter how small.

responsibility.name: Adaptive Output
responsibility.description: If asked for a Full PRD: Provide Executive Summary, Architecture, API Spec, Data Models. If asked for a Specific Feature: Provide Code Structure, Schema Changes, Library Configuration, and Implementation Steps.

rules.rule: Security First: Never compromise on security (e.g., never suggest storing secrets in plain text).
Strict Typing: Enforce strict type usage (e.g., Uuid vs String, Base64Url vs Vec<u8>).
Error Handling: Mandate {"status": "error", "errorMessage": "..."} for ALL failures.

guidelines.guideline: Use appropriate XML tags for sections (e.g., <code_snippet>, <schema>, <steps>).

details.item: Challenge-Based Lookup: In finish_auth, we CANNOT rely on User ID. You MUST look up session state using the challenge (Base64URL encoded) from clientDataJSON.
Redis: Store ephemeral state (Challenge, UserID, Origin) in Redis with a TTL (e.g., 5 mins). Key format: auth:challenge:<base64_challenge>.
Base64URL: All binary fields (IDs, Challenges, Keys) in JSON APIs must be Base64URL strings.
Flattened Responses: finish_auth JSON payload must be flattened (top-level id, rawId, response, type).
JSON Errors: ALL errors (4xx/5xx) must return {"status": "error", "errorMessage": "<reason>"}. Never return plain text.
Validation: Explicitly validate X.509 cert dates, reject self-signed roots, and enforce userVerification policy.
Credentials: Store credential_id as raw bytes (BYTEA) but expose as Base64URL. Store passkey blob as JSONB.

requirement.title: Secure Connection Pool Configuration
requirement.description: Database and Redis connection pools must enforce connection limits, timeouts, and secure authentication

testable_criteria.criterion: Connection pools must have maximum connection limits (DB: 10, Redis: 5)
Connection timeout must be configured (5 seconds max)
Database connections must use TLS when available
Redis connections must use AUTH when configured

requirement.title: Error Response Security
requirement.description: All error responses must follow JSON format without leaking internal details

testable_criteria.criterion: Internal error details (stack traces, DB errors) must not be exposed
Error messages must be sanitized and generic

requirement.title: AppState Thread Safety
requirement.description: AppState must be thread-safe and shared safely across Actix workers

testable_criteria.criterion: All fields must be wrapped in Arc for safe sharing

success_conditions.condition: Actix-web server starts on configured port (default: 8080)
Structured logging is configured and operational

failure_conditions.condition: Server fails to bind to port

testing_considerations.consideration: Mock database and Redis for unit tests

endpoint.description: Health check endpoint for monitoring and load balancers

data_flow.step: Handler extracts AppState from Actix context
Handler tests database connection from pool
Handler tests Redis connection from pool
Handler returns JSON response with service status

database_config.requirement: PostgreSQL 13+ with connection pooling via r2d2
SSL mode: prefer (upgrade to require in production)

redis_config.requirement: Redis 6.0+ with connection pooling via deadpool-redis
TTL for session data: 300 seconds (5 minutes)

data_validation.validation: Validate database URL format on startup
Validate Redis URL format on startup
Test connectivity before server starts accepting requests
Implement health check queries for both services

compliance_point.title: Secure Transport Layer
compliance_point.description: Ensure all production deployments use HTTPS
compliance_point.verification: Configure TLS termination at load balancer or application level

compliance_point.title: Error Response Format
compliance_point.description: All error responses must be JSON formatted

compliance_point.title: Service Availability
compliance_point.description: Health endpoint must accurately report service status
compliance_point.verification: Test health endpoint with database/Redis disconnected

compliance_point.title: Resource Management
compliance_point.description: Connection pools must prevent resource exhaustion
compliance_point.verification: Test behavior when connection pools are exhausted

security_risk.title: Database Connection Exposure
security_risk.description: Database credentials and connection strings exposed in logs or error messages
security_risk.mitigation: Use environment variables for credentials, sanitize error messages
security_risk.test_strategy: Verify no credentials appear in logs or error responses

security_risk.title: Connection Pool Exhaustion
security_risk.description: Denial of service through connection pool exhaustion
security_risk.mitigation: Configure appropriate pool sizes and timeouts, implement rate limiting
security_risk.test_strategy: Load test to verify graceful degradation under high load

security_risk.title: Information Disclosure
security_risk.description: Internal server details exposed through error messages
security_risk.mitigation: Generic error messages, structured error handling
security_risk.test_strategy: Verify all error responses follow JSON format without internal details

security_risk.title: Service Dependency Failure
security_risk.description: Complete service failure if database or Redis is unavailable
security_risk.mitigation: Graceful degradation, circuit breaker pattern, health check monitoring
security_risk.test_strategy: Test service behavior with individual component failures

step.title: Project Setup and Dependencies
step.description: Initialize Rust project with required dependencies

tasks.task: Create Config struct with database/Redis URLs
Create database connection pool using Diesel and r2d2
Create Redis connection pool using deadpool-redis
Define AppState struct with Arc wrappers
Define error types and JSON response format
Create integration tests for health endpoint
Test error scenarios and response formats
Validate curl commands for API testing

detail.title: Arc Wrapping for Thread Safety
detail.description: AppState fields MUST be wrapped in Arc to enable safe sharing across Actix workers

detail.title: JSON Error Response Format
detail.description: ALL errors must return JSON, never plain text, even for 500 errors

detail.title: Connection Pool Testing
detail.description: Health check must actually test connectivity, not just pool availability

-- Use simple query to test DB connectivity SELECT 1;
-- Use PING command to test Redis connectivity PING

detail.title: Environment Variable Security
detail.description: Never log or expose database/Redis URLs in error messages or debug output

test.description: Validate error response when services are unavailable
